# Business Buddy: code map

**What it is:** How to open a small business in Montréal, step by step: barber shop, bakery, café, cleaning, trades and more. Permits, taxes, costs and a personal launch plan.
**Live:** https://business-buddy.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/business-buddy · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `business-buddy/.claude/skills/businessbuddy/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py businessbuddy` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **The knowledge base lives in `theme/assets/bb.js`** (window.BB: categories, phases, tasks, permits, glossary, sources, stages, 22 topics, 30 guides, money/search/plan helpers, the street SVG, confetti), moved unchanged from the JS version's `web/pages/_kb_*.html`. Python reaches it only through `client_code/bb.py` (JSON text via `BB.json`), so pages get plain dicts. Task ids and guide/topic slugs are stored in plans, bookmarks, votes and page_stats: never rename one (test_server.py checks the demo data's ids against bb.js).
- Guide intros, rules, "the money" and topic sections are our own HTML: shown by `Components/Prose` (property `content`). Every list around them is a RepeatingPanel + `Items/*`; items write their text with `dom_nodes[...].textContent`.
- **Router**: visitors get the menu and phone tab bar too (Guides, Basics, Tools; members also Home): `router.nav_links`, `router.PARENT` lights up Guides on #guide, Basics on #topic/#glossary, Home on #plan. Guide/topic tab titles come from bb. `#library?q=word` opens with a search.
- **Save + "was this helpful?"**: `Components/SaveButton` and `Components/VoteBox`; the page calls `page_state` once (it counts the view) and passes the reply to both (`setup(kind, slug, st)`). "Report outdated info" opens Prepsto.
- **Plan page** (`Pages/Plan`): `Items/PlanPhase` + `Items/Task` and `Items/BudgetRow` call back into the page (`host.tick/save_note/is_closed/budget_changed/remove_row`). Closed phases stay in browser storage `businessbuddy.closed.<plan id>` (same key as the JS version). Ticks save quietly and roll back with a toast if the server refuses.
- **Tools** (`Pages/Tools`): one page, six parts; answers in browser storage under the JS version's keys (finder, be, tx, th, rt, sq) via `bb.store_get/store_set`. Finder and structure quiz = `Items/Question` with `Items/Chip` answers (host = a `Quiz`).
- Design: the "storefront awning" (cream paper, brick red, teal, striped awning band, Fraunces + Inter) is the brand and kept; the awning stripes are marked design-ok; eyebrow labels were folded into headings in the conversion; `--c-faint`, `--c-accent` and `--c-warn` were darkened a little for WCAG AA.
- Smoke test: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (tools/ui/smoke.js: signed out incl. library chips/search, tools and glossary filter; a new member makes a plan from the bakery guide, ticks, budget, details, save + vote; admin tabs; 1280 + 390 px).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **page_stats**: kind:str, slug:str, views:num, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Library
- **plans**: owner→users, guide:str, title:str, area:str, target_date:date, done:obj, notes:obj, costs:obj, hiring:bool, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Library, Plans
- **saved**: owner→users, kind:str, slug:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in DemoData, Library
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData
- **votes**: user→users, kind:str, slug:str, helpful:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Library

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
